title: Codes
description: Extract alphanumeric codes from the input. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name or list of input columns.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name or list of output columns.

parameters.name: first_element
parameters.description: Get the first element from results.

parameters.name: char
parameters.description: Character to use when output_format is concatenate.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Controls filtering of likely false positives such as measurements. Lenient skips this filter; balanced and strict currently apply the same filter. Default is balanced. Unless min_length is provided, minimum lengths default to 3 for lenient, 4 for balanced, and 5 for strict.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Default is input order. Also allows longest or shortest.

parameters.name: disallowed_patterns
parameters.description: A pattern or JSON array of regex patterns to not include in the found codes.

parameters.name: include_multi_part_tokens
parameters.description: Whether to include multi-part tokens that have a space. Default True.

parameters.name: extract_raw
parameters.description: Whether to return tokens with their adjacent non-whitespace characters included, rather than the cleaned token. Default False.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Extract alphanumeric codes from unstructured text. Can be performed on one column or multiple columns. Requires WrangleWorks Account. ## Migrated examples #### Extracting Codes From Single Column ##### Recipe ```yaml # One column input wrangles: - extract.codes: input: Secret output: Code Extract ```
##### Input Sample _No sample available._
##### Output Sample | Secret | Code Extract | | --- | --- | | to gain access use Z1ON0101 | ['Z1ON0101'] |
#### Extracting Codes From Multiple Columns ##### Recipe ```yaml # Multi column input wrangles: - extract.codes: input: - code1 - code2 output: Codes ```
##### Input Sample _No sample available._
##### Output Sample | Codes | code1 | code2 | | --- | --- | --- | | ['CH465517080-1', 'CH465517080-2'] | code CH465517080-1 | code CH465517080-2 |
